subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR can make the visible badge less alarming, but the chosen implementation changes a security-sensitive file metadata boundary and may affect shared Gateway callers.

options.title: Keep fs-safe boundary
options.body: Require the PR to remove raw stat fallback and solve external paths through filtering, neutral UI state, or another fs-safe-preserving contract.

options.title: Accept external metadata
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately allow existence, size, and mtime metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but that needs explicit security acceptance and regression coverage.

options.title: Split layout from metadata
options.body: Treat the current-main layout fix as complete and leave this PR focused only on the remaining Missing-label semantics after rebase.

recommendation.title: Keep fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Require the PR to remove raw stat fallback and solve external paths through filtering, neutral UI state, or another fs-safe-preserving contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the session workspace rail and are the strongest code-history owner for the affected Gateway/UI contract.
